note: Parks Victoria publishes a map position of -38.3131, 144.69 for the tents. That is 300 m from the record's pin and consistent with it, so this row supports the claim - but only to the precision the source publishes. The longitude is given to two decimal places, a rounding cell of plus or minus 0.005 degrees, about 550 m at this latitude, so this source cannot resolve anything finer than roughly half a kilometre. The Point Nepean entries that landed in the bay on 2026-08-21 were wrong by less than that. Support, bounded in the same breath, which is why visit sits second in this class ahead of every remote publisher including this one.
